steps.content: A magnificent sculpture, or rather, a dark gate, shows up before the Sinners. It seems bottomless and leads to another world.
The gateposts on either side are carved with people struggling in pain. The way to the abyss is crowded with them, wailing and crying out in fear.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Gate of Hell</color>. It was Enfer's most famous work in her early years.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Born in N.F. 109, it was the beginning of the sculptor's transitions. Enfer began to search for a unique artistic style.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: And according to more widely circulated rumors, the Gate of Hell reflects the deepest fear within everyone's heart.
Something is rampaging before the Gate of Hell. Its face is blurred, but the halo around its head shows that it's anything but human. It must be another phantom born during the bizarre night.
But its shape is unmistakably familiar, ad the red light flashing on its hand—shackles. It's the power unique to that person.
...Surrender...
Surrender... to the shackles...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Another phantom of fear. Even the Gate of Hell has been affected by the mutation...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Shackles? But that's no human. He's not Labyrinth's Master.
steps.female_content: Shackles? But that's no human. She's not Labyrinth's Master.

steps.content: The Gate of Hell's commotion draws all Sinners here, leading to an unexpected reunion.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What took you guys so long?! Where have you been all this time?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Keep your voice down. You're attracting the attention of the enemy.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Geez... The brainless creatures I was hoping not to run into.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Look ahead! Look ahead!!
Surrender to me!!!
There's no time to revel in the joy of the reunion. Something shoots down from the sky, cracking the ground. For the first time, they are attacked by the shackles!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhhh, help! Chief, stop this. It's me, EMP! Ah!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Keep your head clear. That's not the Chief. It's just a phantom born from fear.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What fear phantom? Which one of you idiots is scared again? Who is afraid of that numbnut?!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Scan complete. Master is nearby, but there is too much obstruction. Clean-up mode immediately activated, set at highest tier three.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: These are artworks, and your shorted-out processor is the most significant obstruction... Stop it!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: The next attack is coming... Chief!! Help!!!
Don't be afraid! That's not something you should fear!

A powerful energy bursts out of the darkness, repelling the raging <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>. It's also the shackles, but instead of the constricting force that overwhelmed them, it feels warm and familiar.
A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in his hands.
steps.female_content: A familiar figure emerges from the darkness on the other side of the corridor, with redness burning in her hands.

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
What took you so long?!
...It has been a while indeed. Seeing them again, you unconsciously start to smile.

options: I've been waiting for you too.
The protagonist always shows up at final critical moments.

steps.content: The fear vanishes, and the shackles finally return to the Sinners.
